title_en: Nintendo Offers Free Repair Services to Anyone in Area Impacted by Deadly Earthquake
summary_en: Free repair offer comes in conjunction with a donation to the Kumamoto earthquake relief fund effort.
body_en:
In the aftermath of last week’s deadly Kumamoto earthquake in Japan, Nintendo has announced it will be donating 50 million yen to the relief fund effort via the Japanese Red Cross Society. On top of this, the company will be offering free repair services to anyone in the area impacted by the quake until February 1, 2027.
The news comes via Nintendo’s official social media channel , where it extended “deepest condolences to all those affected by the Kumamoto Earthquake of Reiwa 8.”
Nintendo’s contribution follows support previously offered by The Pokémon Company , which has donated 100 million yen to relief efforts. Sony has also committed to providing 50 million yen through both a relief fund operated by Save the Children Japan and Sony, as well as through the Japanese Red Cross Society.
The Kumamoto earthquake struck southern Japan on July 28, 2026. The magnitude 6.8 quake has resulted in the deaths of at least 38 people, and more than 120 injured.
Luke is a Senior Editor on the IGN reviews team.
